channel.title: Times of San Diego - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Times of San Diego (timesofsandiego.com)

item.title: Opinion: SD nonprofits create a bold, replicable solution to the housing crisis
item.description: Four San Diego nonprofits are moving beyond grants and services alone to address one of the biggest barriers to building badly-needed housing.

item.title: Mission Beach – Recall the early days of San Diego’s shoreline playground
item.description: Before the boardwalk bustle and amusement park era defined Mission Beach, this long stretch of sand was carving out a quieter seaside identity.

item.title: San Diego County unemployment drops to 4.4% in December
item.description: The unemployment rate in San Diego County decreased to 4.4% in December, down from the November estimate of 4.7% but above the year- ago rate of 4.2%.

item.title: Peninsula Beacon: Jan. 23, 2026
item.description: Peninsula Beacon spotlights focus on proposed Sunset Cliffs Boulevard changes, the reopening of the historic North Chapel, and an Ocean Beach–based sitcom gaining film festival attention. Inside, stories cover infertility insurance, a Point Loma extreme athlete, a new Ocean Beach bakery, and a Point Loma murder trial.

item.title: Fires burn swiftly, but insurance battles linger: New bills propose consumer-friendly regulations
item.description: As fire survivors continue to navigate life after disaster, California lawmakers roll out new bills attempting to further regulate insurance companies.

item.title: California universities still ‘on edge’ over funding despite Newsom’s proposed budget increase
item.description: Despite a proposed a 7% funding increase for California's public universities, officials remain anxious over whether it will come to fruition.

item.title: Activists barricade themselves inside Mayor Gloria’s office, demand action on ICE
item.description: Photos provided by the activists show a list of demands posted in Gloria's office, along with two scrawled signs on the glass doors.

item.title: Five questions with David Lampley: Building Jacumba’s musical oasis in the desert
item.description: From secret shows with touring acts to concerts under the stars from up-and-coming acts, Jacumba Hot Springs concerts are making a mark.

item.title: Poll shows Balboa Park frustration growing ahead of rally against parking fees
item.description: A public opinion poll shows overwhelming opposition among city residents regarding the Balboa Park fees, which began Jan. 5.

item.title: Jury convicts Point Loma man in shooting deaths of sister, nephew, attack on mom
item.description: The shooting occurred just nine days after William Bushey's sister moved in to the Point Loma home he shared with their mother.
